summary: The second P4 run passed 203 tests and the complete Java demonstration but found real mobile overflow. Executed the layout repair and closed additional schema-to-runtime review gaps before repeating final acceptance.
findings: Long immutable IDs and default quotation margins overflowed a 390-pixel screen; the browser retained a screenshot of the failure.
The runtime could mark source coverage complete for an unreviewed retained-source inventory, contrary to the design's cross-record checks.
Adjudicated issues referenced decision IDs directly instead of validated evidence linked to those decisions.
Successors preserved root identities but needed to retain their local root/parent context too.
changes: Wrap long identifiers, reduce mobile quotation margins and capture the mobile screen at its top.
Add authenticated exact-source inventory review and require it for retained-source coverage readiness.
Persist HUMAN_ADJUDICATION evidence and validate evidence authority/source/content during report reconciliation.
Carry complete unresolved issue ancestor chains into successors, with fresh unresolved state and scoped run identities.
Regenerate the actual OpenAPI before its stability check in P4.
regression: Retained-source inventory cannot become complete through author assertion.
Adjudication evidence resolves to the exact authenticated decision and survives report validation.
Repeat all regressions, Java host/751 cases, browser and offline package checks.
